## [0.0.21-hg17.2](https://github.com/AAK1767/HushGram17/releases/tag/v0.0.21-hg17.2) (2026-11-21)

### Features in HushGram17

* **Save Instants**: Captures received view-once Instants on this phone while viewing them, and saves them to a local vault so you can reopen, download, or copy links later. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.
* Full upstream HushGram 0.0.21 feature set included.
